themes.title: Far-right push for 'national priority' policies
themes.blurb: Right-wing parties across Europe are intensifying their advocacy for 'national priority' policies, which prioritize citizens over immigrants in access to public services and benefits. This theme has gained traction in Spain, Italy, France, the UK, and Germany, with parties like Vox, Fratelli d'Italia, Rassemblement National, Reform UK, and AfD leading the charge. The policies often include residency requirements for social housing and healthcare, reflecting a broader anti-immigration agenda.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Vox secured 'national priority' policies in Andalusia's coalition deal with PP, requiring 10 years of residency for social housing and prioritizing Spaniards in public aid.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Meloni's government emphasizes national sovereignty in policy-making, aligning with 'national priority' rhetoric in debates over EU migration policies.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: RN continues to advocate for policies that prioritize French citizens in welfare and public services, a key campaign promise for 2027.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Reform UK's manifesto includes proposals to prioritize British citizens in housing and healthcare, echoing Vox's policies.

countries.name: 🇩🇪 Alternative für Deutschland
countries.note: AfD's platform includes strict residency requirements for social benefits, aligning with the broader 'national priority' theme.

themes.title: Right-wing parties target LGBTQ+ rights in Europe
themes.blurb: Far-right and right-wing parties in Europe are increasingly targeting LGBTQ+ rights, framing them as part of a broader cultural and ideological battle. This trend is evident in Spain, Italy, France, the UK, and Poland, where parties like Vox, Fratelli d'Italia, Rassemblement National, Reform UK, and PiS are pushing back against progressive policies, including gender education in schools and anti-discrimination laws.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Vox's Andalusian coalition deal with PP includes banning 'indoctrination' in schools, targeting gender and LGBTQ+ education.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Meloni's government has rolled back LGBTQ+ protections, including restrictions on surrogacy and gender recognition.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: RN opposes progressive gender policies, advocating for traditional family values and restricting LGBTQ+ rights in its 2027 platform.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Reform UK has criticized 'gender ideology' in schools, aligning with Vox's stance on banning LGBTQ+ education.

countries.name: 🇵🇱 Prawo i Sprawiedliwość
countries.note: PiS continues to oppose LGBTQ+ rights, framing them as a threat to traditional Polish values.

themes.title: AfD's constitutional crisis and far-right extremism
themes.blurb: Germany's AfD is facing a constitutional crisis amid rising extremism within its ranks, with internal divisions over leadership and ideology. The party's alignment with far-right rhetoric has sparked protests and legal challenges, particularly ahead of regional elections in Saxony-Anhalt and Thüringen. Similar concerns about far-right extremism are echoed in France and Italy, where parties like Rassemblement National and Fratelli d'Italia are also navigating internal tensions.

countries.name: 🇩🇪 Alternative für Deutschland
countries.note: AfD's Erfurt party congress saw protests and internal debates over extremism, with leaders like Björn Höcke pushing for a more radical agenda.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: RN faces legal challenges over alleged extremism, including investigations into EU fund misuse and Marine Le Pen's ineligibility ruling.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Meloni's government distances itself from far-right extremism but faces criticism for alliances with radical factions like Vannacci's Futuro Nazionale.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Reform UK faces scrutiny over extremist rhetoric, including Nigel Farage's controversial statements on immigration and LGBTQ+ rights.

themes.title: Javier Milei's regional alliances and anti-socialism bloc
themes.blurb: Argentinian President Javier Milei is expanding his regional influence by forming alliances with right-wing leaders in Latin America, particularly in Peru and Brazil. His anti-socialism bloc aims to counter left-wing governments and promote free-market policies. This theme resonates with right-wing movements in the U.S., where Trump's MAGA movement shares similar ideological goals.

countries.name: 🇦🇷 La Libertad Avanza
countries.note: Milei congratulated Peru's Keiko Fujimori on her election victory, emphasizing shared anti-socialist goals and regional cooperation.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Trump's administration aligns with Milei's anti-socialist rhetoric, with figures like Marco Rubio advocating for similar policies in Latin America.

countries.name: 🇵🇪 Peru (external)
countries.note: Keiko Fujimori's victory in Peru strengthens Milei's regional bloc, with both leaders emphasizing economic freedom and anti-corruption.

countries.name: 🇧🇷 Brazil (external)
countries.note: Milei's anti-socialist stance resonates with Brazil's right-wing movements, though Lula's government remains a counterpoint.

themes.title: Right-wing coalition governments in Spain
themes.blurb: Spain's conservative Partido Popular (PP) and far-right Vox are forming coalition governments in multiple regions, including Andalusia, Extremadura, Aragón, and Castilla y León. These coalitions reflect a broader trend of right-wing parties normalizing far-right participation in government, despite opposition criticism. The agreements often include policies prioritizing national citizens and restricting immigration.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Vox secured key roles in Andalusia's government, including a vice-presidency and control over tourism, justice, and local administration.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Partido Popular
countries.note: PP formed coalition governments with Vox in Andalusia, Extremadura, Aragón, and Castilla y León, normalizing far-right participation.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 PSOE (opposition)
countries.note: PSOE criticizes PP-Vox coalitions as a threat to democracy and human rights, warning of far-right influence.
